{{Quote|It's not an Imperial garrison. My sources indicate that Milvayne is an Ubiqtorate base. An Ubiqtorate base is not something my troops are prepared to deal with. And neither are yours.|[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="DoO" />}}
The '''attack on Milvayne''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in the final quarter of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. It resulted in a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] defeat and the split between [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Bail Organa agreed that the attack was required to shut down Imperial control in Gyrica system.|Mon Mothma to Garm Bel Iblis|<ref name="DoO" />}}
Prior to the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] proposed an attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Milvayne/Legends|Milvayne]], the location of the most important [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] in the [[Gyrica system/Legends|Gyrica system]]. The attack was supported by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] before his [[Death/Legends|death]] but Mon Mothma didn't seek the approval of [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]].<ref name="DoO" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Mon Mothma, I am forced to disagree. The course you are embarking on is foolhardy. I request that you postpone and reconsider the attack on Milvayne.|Garm Bel Iblis to Mon Mothma|<ref name="DoO" />}}
Following the [[disaster at Deepspace Besh]],<ref name="TEA" /> Mon Mothma ordered the attack to be carried out. However, Bel Iblis's information indicated that Milvayne didn't house an Imperial garrison but an Ubiqtorate base, a target [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] troops were not prepared to deal with. Before the beginning of the attack, Bel Iblis requested Mothma that she postponed and reconsidered the strike. Mothma overruled him, but a furious Bel Iblis accused her of amassing power for herself. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] stated that none of his troops would have a part in the attack and the quarrel increased until Mothma coolly told him that the Rebellion no longer required his services.<ref name="DoO" /> The battle eventually occurred but Rebel forces were defeated as expected by Bel Iblis.<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Do you understand me? I will not send my troops on a suicide attack. And I do not recognize your authority to order them to. I did not vote to place you in charge of the Alliance, and if Bail did, then he was gravely mistaken." <br /> "Senator Bel Iblis, I sincerely hope that was not an ultimatum." <br /> "Yes, I guess it is. This attack plan is fundamentally flawed, and you just don't have the expertise to know it." <br /> "I will not have ultimatums put to me, Senator. The Rebel Alliance will no longer require your services.|Garm Bel Iblis and Mon Mothma|<ref name="DoO" />}}
In addition to the military defeat,<ref name="TEA" /> the Rebel Alliance lost one of its most brilliant leaders. Garm Bel Iblis created his own [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|resistance movement]] and waged his private war against the Empire for years throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Bel Iblis eventually joined Mon Mothma and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="DFRSb">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
